resultsProcessor.script: console.log('test-trigger-start');var response=context.sendToStep('same-slot-caller','{}');if(response.isErrored()){throw new Error(String(response.getAllErrors()[0]));}var body=JSON.parse(response.getBody()||'{}');if(body.pong!==true){throw new Error('caller did not echo: '+JSON.stringify(body));}console.log('test-trigger-ok');context.sendMetric('test-trigger-ok', 1.0);context.setBody(JSON.stringify(body));
